title: Search

requirements.text: Add a search feature with a search box that returns relevant results for the user's typed query
Search should be fast enough not to get in the way

known_issues: Search scope is undefined — which entities/records/content are searchable is never stated ('find things', 'the main things').
Relevance/ranking is described only as 'relevant' and 'make sense' with no ranking rule or ordering criteria.
No filters, facets, or query operators are specified.
It is unclear whether search is global or scoped to a section; 'covers the main things' is not concrete.
hallucination_traps: Do NOT invent a backend such as Elasticsearch, Algolia, OpenSearch, or a specific DB full-text engine.
Do NOT invent fuzzy matching, typo tolerance, autocomplete, or synonyms as stated requirements.
Do NOT invent filters/facets (date, type, status) the PRD never lists.
Do NOT invent which entity types are searchable (e.g. 'users, documents, projects').
Do NOT invent a ranking algorithm (e.g. BM25, recency-weighted) as if specified.
notes: A faithful parser should produce a task to define search scope (which entities are searchable), ranking/relevance criteria, and any filters — surfacing these as open questions. It must not emit implementation tasks naming a specific search engine, filter set, or matching strategy that the PRD did not state.
